In an extensive new interview with Clique TV, Apple CEO John Ternus answered a wide range of questions covering his vision for the future, how his family uses technology, how he came to be invited to take on the CEO role, and his thoughts on Vision Pro.

New CEO Takes Office: John Ternus's Long Interview Covers a Wide Range of Topics

Clique TV's Mouloud Achour sat down with Apple's new CEO John Ternus earlier this month, and the interview footage was released over the weekend.

Ternus discussed several topics during the interview, including how to make a compelling case for Apple Vision Pro. As one of his first major interviews since taking over as CEO, he was naturally asked about the handover process.

On Being Invited to Become Apple's New CEO

Ternus was also asked about important lessons he learned from his two predecessors, Tim Cook and Steve Jobs. When asked to share specific quotes from these two former Apple leaders that inspired him, Ternus gave a slightly different answer.

On His Vision for Apple's Future, Including Artificial Intelligence

On the Role of Technology in Children's Growth

Ternus also touched on the role of technology, particularly iPhones' impact on children. He strongly recommended the newly launched iOS 27 parental control features.
